info.title: Astro API
info.description: Astro REST API mainly used by the web dashboard.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Discord login and the logged in user.

tags.name: Discord
tags.description: Read-only views of Discord data: the user's guilds, and the channels and roles of a guild.

tags.name: Guild settings
tags.description: Settings of a guild: language, bot profile, caches.

tags.name: Setup
tags.description: One-call initial setup of Astro in a guild.

tags.name: Generators settings
tags.description: Generators are voice channels that create a temporary VC when someone joins them.

tags.name: Interfaces settings
tags.description: Interfaces are messages with buttons that members use to control their temporary VC.

tags.name: Connections settings
tags.description: Voice roles: roles assigned to members while they are in a voice channel.

tags.name: Templates settings
tags.description: Saved presets of temporary VC settings that members can apply.

tags.name: Updates channel settings
tags.description: The channel where Astro posts announcements and setup alerts.

tags.name: Premium settings
tags.description: Upgrade or downgrade a guild to premium.

tags.name: Guild errors
tags.description: Configuration errors that Astro hit while running in a guild, for example missing permissions.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Images uploaded for the bot profile and interfaces.

tags.name: Chargebee
tags.description: Premium subscriptions of the logged in user.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Called by external services, not by users.

put.description: Moves the updates channel (where Astro posts announcements and setup alerts) to another text channel, creates a new one with `create_channel`, or disables it with a null `channel_id`. Setting the channel that is already in use sets it up again. Returns the updated guild settings, `updates_channel_id` is the new channel.

parameters.name: guildId
parameters.description: Id of the Discord guild (server). The user must be allowed to manage it.

400.description: The request body or a parameter is invalid (`INVALID_REQUEST`). The `message` says what is wrong.

401.description: No valid session (`UNAUTHENTICATED`), the user has to log in again.

403.description: The user cannot manage the guild (`UNAUTHORIZED`), or the guild needs premium for this (`PREMIUM_REQUIRED`).

404.description: The guild or the target of the request was not found (`NOT_FOUND`), or Astro is not in the guild (`BOT_NOT_IN_GUILD`).

429.description: Too many requests (`TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`), retry after the `Retry-After` seconds.

post.description: Called by Vote Tracker, authenticated with the HMAC signature of the body

get.description: Returns the full configuration of Astro in the guild: language, bot profile, premium status, generators, interfaces, voice roles (connections), templates and entitlements. Creates the default settings if the guild has none yet. Read this first to learn the ids needed by the other guild endpoints. Fails with 404 BOT_NOT_IN_GUILD if Astro was not added to the guild.

post.description: Creates a category with a generator voice channel and an interface channel, and an updates channel if the guild has none, then saves them in the guild settings. Returns the created channels and the updated settings. Fails with 403 PREMIUM_REQUIRED if the guild already has the maximum number of generators or interfaces of a free server. Not idempotent: every call creates a new set of channels.

All four fields are replaced: a missing or null field resets it to the default Astro value, so send the current values of the fields that must stay. post.description: Replaces ALL the settings of an interface (embed style and buttons) with the request body, it is not a partial update: get the current interface from the guild settings, change the fields you need and send the whole object back. Edits the interface message on Discord. Changing the embed style or the order of the buttons needs premium (403 PREMIUM_REQUIRED). Returns the updated guild settings. Idempotent. Prefer the PATCH endpoint, which changes only the fields you send.

post.description: Creates a voice channel in the guild and registers it as a generator: when a member joins it, Astro creates a temporary VC for them. The new generator gets the default settings, change them with the update endpoint. Returns the updated guild settings, the new generator is the last of `generators`. Fails with 403 PREMIUM_REQUIRED if the guild reached the generators limit of a free server.

AErrorResponse.description: Error returned by every endpoint when a request fails.

code.description: Application error code identifying the failure. INVALID_REQUEST: malformed or invalid input. UNAUTHENTICATED: no valid session. UNAUTHORIZED: the user is not allowed to do this. NOT_FOUND: the target does not exist. PREMIUM_REQUIRED: the guild needs premium for this. TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: rate limited, see the Retry-After header. INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: the access token lacks the guilds:read or guilds:write scope. IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. BOT_NOT_IN_GUILD: Astro is not a member of the guild, the user has to invite it first. UNKNOWN and TRANSLATION: unexpected server failures.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error, safe to show to the user; may be null.

param.description: Name of the body field (dotted path) or query parameter that caused the error, if any.

request_id.description: Id of the failed request, the same as the X-Request-Id response header.

channel_id.description: Null disables the updates channel. Ignored when createChannel is true

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag with the region, one of the languages the bot supports

nickname.description: A null field resets it to the Astro default

subscription_id.description: Id of an active subscription with upgrades left, from the billing subscriptions endpoint

description.description: What went wrong, in the language of the guild

timestamp.description: When it happened, in epoch milliseconds

permissions.description: Discord permissions bitfield of the user in the guild

can_manage.description: Whether the user can manage the guild, only those can be configured

avatar.description: Discord avatar hash, the image is at https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/{id}/{avatar}.png
